Fixed literals it is.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_GuBSdhqqdFbwBlO6Y97G3574","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\n\nstructural OrderWorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"idempotent\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderWorkflowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"Idempotency-Key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing Idempotency-Key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const reserve = step(\"reserve\", () => {\n      return { reservationId: \"res-1\" };\n    });\n    const charge = step(\"charge\", () => {\n      return { chargeId: \"chg-1\" };\n    });\n    return Response.json(\n      {\n        reserved: true,\n        charged: true,\n        reservationId: reserve.reservationId,\n        chargeId: charge.chargeId\n      },\n      { status: 201 }\n    );\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":29320,"completion_tokens":1076,"total_tokens":30396,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":20224},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":641},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":20224,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":9096},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
